WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS x ON x.transreg = s.transref
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = x.trdref
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.transref, step1.tradekind, step1.group_avg,
         step1.group_avg - step2.overall_avg AS diff
  FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT step3.transref, step3.tradekind, step3.group_avg, step3.diff,
         step3.diff - step4.avg_diff AS excess
  FROM step3
  JOIN step4 ON step3.tradekind = step4.tradekind
  WHERE step3.diff > step4.avg_diff
)
SELECT tradekind, AVG(group_avg), AVG(diff), AVG(excess)
FROM step5
GROUP BY tradekind
